data.how_to_apply: The page states that everyone is welcome to apply, with priority given to junior members such as full- or part-time students of computer science and related fields. Volunteers receive a complimentary conference registration (including access to all sessions and proceedings), free lunches/refreshments, a volunteer shirt, and free admission to social events, though they must arrange their own travel and accommodation. To apply, one should follow the instruction in the Applications section.
